installation.notes: Codex project adapter; installed by scripts/05-install-into-project.ps1.

repository_read.implementation: Codex permission profiles deny external filesystem access and reopen the workspace read-only where appropriate

product_write.implementation: aledevos_writer grants workspace writes while protected control-plane paths remain read-only

control_plane_write_deny.implementation: more-specific :workspace_roots permissions keep .aledevos/.codex/.agents/AGENTS/.git read-only for writers

arbitrary_shell_deny.implementation: shell disabled for writer/read-only roles; state roles are confined to state-only writes with network disabled

canonical_gate.implementation: verifier role runs protected .aledevos runtime under state-runner profile

scope_prewrite.implementation: Codex role permission profiles enforce control-plane boundaries; task-specific dynamic product-scope narrowing remains deterministic prepass

scope_prepass.implementation: portable deterministic scope check blocks PASS and emits SCOPE_ESCALATION

external_directory.implementation: Codex permission profiles set :root=deny and reopen only :minimal plus :workspace_roots with role-specific access

network.implementation: Codex permission profiles set network.enabled=false; only state runner permits local binding

code_mode.implementation: Code Mode and Code Mode host disabled in project and role layers

compaction.implementation: Codex native context compaction plus portable ContextOS checkpoint/resume discipline
compaction.notes: Exact target model context window remains runtime/model dependent; generic-64k portable budget is used until target telemetry overrides it.

structured_handoff.implementation: portable handoff contract + Codex native multi-agent roles

context_budget.implementation: portable ContextOS engine using generic runtime profile; Codex exact telemetry remains runtime evidence

checkpoint_resume.implementation: portable ContextOS checkpoint/resume engine with SHA-256 sealed state under .aledevos/state/contextos
checkpoint_resume.notes: Exact automatic token telemetry feed is deferred to ContextOS telemetry phase; OpenCode native compaction remains a safety net.

preventive_transition.implementation: ContextOS pressure bands require verified checkpoint + resume before COMPACT_REQUIRED/HARD_GUARD transitions
preventive_transition.notes: Adapter-specific automatic invocation is completed when telemetry wiring is added.

diff_first.implementation: portable ContextOS bounded git diff snapshot + untracked-file hash/preview without staging
diff_first.notes: Review agents are instructed to escalate from diff to targeted excerpt/full file only when necessary.

context_dedup.implementation: portable SHA-256 context-item ledger + budgeted context packet planner
context_dedup.notes: De-duplicates task payloads; runtime/provider system prompts may still be resent by the runtime.

skill_registry.implementation: portable Skill System + Codex repository skills under .agents/skills

motion_governance.implementation: UX/UI Phase 5 Motion Director + canonical Motion Language + sealed Motion Contracts/Reviews
motion_governance.notes: Specialist motion Skills route on demand through Skill System and Safe Acquisition; rendered visual quality remains Visual QA.

visual_qa_capture_contract.implementation: Visual QA Phase 1 deterministic capture matrix + sealed PNG/source evidence verification
visual_qa_capture_contract.notes: Browser execution is intentionally deferred to Phase 2; Phase 1 makes no visual-quality or regression claim.

visual_qa_browser_capture.implementation: adapter-owned Playwright provider installed for Codex project runtime

visual_qa_regression.implementation: Visual QA Phase 3 immutable approved baseline store + portable deterministic PNG pixel regression + hashed diff/report verification
visual_qa_regression.notes: Only named baseline-pinned tolerance profiles are allowed. Baseline promotion requires explicit approval and is never automatic after FAIL.

visual_qa_runtime_checks.implementation: portable Phase 4 runtime audit over adapter-owned Playwright provider

visual_qa_judge.implementation: Codex visual-judge role + portable Phase 5 semantic judge
visual_qa_judge.notes: Target selected model must demonstrate native image observation; otherwise target preflight BLOCKS.

visual_qa_bounded_repair.implementation: Visual QA Phase 5 sealed repair authorization/cycle controller integrated with the global max_repairs=2 run state
visual_qa_bounded_repair.notes: Repairs are restricted to approved product scope, may not promote baselines or edit canonical policies, and require fresh revisioned P2→P5 evidence before acceptance.

target_runtime_preflight.implementation: portable V1 preflight evaluates Codex/Playwright/model readiness separately from adapter installation

v1_release_validation.implementation: portable sealed V1 release gate is installed unchanged under Codex adapter
